name: EmbedViewer
description: Dark-theme embedded viewer for VideoPlayer and DocumentViewer. Uses the component.embed-* token set (dark gray UI). Includes a top control bar, a canvas area, and playback/navigation controls.

topbar.note: Title, close, fullscreen controls — dark gray bg

canvas.note: Video frame or document page render area

usage.notes: Render inside a Modal(Browser) or fullscreen. Dark theme is intentional — do not override with light colors.

do: Always show a close/exit button in the topbar.
dont: Don't mix light UI elements with the dark embed theme.
Don't render EmbedViewer inside a regular Panel — use a Modal(Browser).
